title: ContextTransitionPayload
description: Structured v3.0.0 isolated context transition contract (Context Fork) across DAG waves and nodes in chained-plan-orchestrator

phase_id.description: Unique node or phase identifier (e.g., step_01_react_discovery)

wave_index.description: Topological parallel wave index compiled via Kahn's algorithm

target_skill.description: Canonical slug of the target skill or declarative subagent

cognitive_pattern.description: Active non-linear cognitive pattern for this node

isolated_state_key.description: Isolated state slot key where the worker writes results without fan-out collisions

input_payload.description: Minimal scoped payload strictly required by this node (raw conversation history forbidden)

active_rules.description: Up to 5 operational rules active in this step (Prompt Complexity Wall Shield)

target_files.description: Files modified by this node, checked for parallel write collisions within the same wave

expected_outputs.description: Concrete output artifacts expected upon node completion

acceptance_criteria.description: Falsifiable verification checks required for Go transition

fallback_branch.description: Non-linear contingency node triggered on recoverable failure

status.description: Current finite-state status of the node
